npcs.name: Ora Softhands
npcs.description: Familiar face at bedside lamps across town; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable midwife are sent to Ora, who claims bedside lamps across town as home ground. At 54, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. She washes her hands as ritual and science; neighbors joke that she would miss a coronation before misplacing the kit bag with lavender and clean linen. Trusted by many; link to Petra; saw Vale jewelry. She is saving courage and coin alike to train Petra as a proper clinic partner, while trying not to let losing a mother to pride or poverty decide the ending. Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; washes her hands as ritual and science.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at bedside lamps across town long enough to train Petra as a proper clinic partner.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.rumor: Ora is writing a private list of debts the council will not touch.
npcs.voice: Measured human cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; kit bag with lavender and clean linen always nearby.

npcs.name: Mol Deeprow
npcs.description: Local gravedigger whose days orbit the laddered graves behind chapel and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Mol Deeprow keeps the laddered graves behind chapel running with the stubborn patience of a 49-year-old Human who has already survived worse seasons than this one. He whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested, and the shovel with measurement notches is usually within reach when tempers rise. Works with Bram; holds physical evidence. His private aim is plain enough: keep the flood memorial neat for Bram. Still, he flinches at the thought of burying someone still claimed by the living. Lately the trouble under his nose is this: Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: keep the flood memorial neat for Bram.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.
npcs.rumor: The shovel with measurement notches once belonged to a person who vanished upriver.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Human features shaped by work at the laddered graves behind chapel; watch for the shovel with measurement notches.

npcs.name: Skit Needlefang
npcs.description: A ratcatcher rooted at alleys, cellars, and pantries, known for how he names rats before he catches them.
npcs.biography: Skit did not plan to become the town's go-to ratcatcher, yet alleys, cellars, and pantries made the choice sticky. Now 35, the Gnome measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He names rats before he catches them, and keeps the cage of squeaks and a crooked grin like a confessor keeps secrets. Knows Mouse's world from below; evidence for undercroft. Hope pulls one way—be paid on contract by the council, not in scraps—while caution pulls the other because of plague talk turning into torch talk. Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; names rats before he catches them.
npcs.motivation: To be paid on contract by the council, not in scraps without feeding plague talk turning into torch talk.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.
npcs.rumor: Skit is writing a private list of debts the council will not touch.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A gnome silhouette framed by alleys, cellars, and pantries, hands seldom empty of the cage of squeaks and a crooked grin.

npcs.name: Bea Heartstring
npcs.description: Familiar face at tea shops and festival dances; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Bea did not plan to become the town's go-to matchmaker, yet tea shops and festival dances made the choice sticky. Now 63, the Halfling measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. She asks about siblings before asking about love, and keeps the ribbon ledger of almost-engagements like a confessor keeps secrets. Gossips with Issy; ships Pippa/Tomas; spotted Lysa's exit plan. Hope pulls one way—see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision—while caution pulls the other because of arranging a match that hides abuse. Noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; asks about siblings before asking about love.
npcs.motivation: Protect her place at tea shops and festival dances long enough to see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies that noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
npcs.rumor: Bea can open doors at tea shops and festival dances after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; ribbon ledger of almost-engagements always nearby.
